questions.subject: CHEMISTRY
questions.stem: A clinician's note asks why gas laws use Kelvin not Celsius.

answer.exemplar: Gas laws use Kelvin because volume and pressure are directly proportional to absolute temperature; Celsius has an arbitrary zero, so ratios of Celsius values give wrong results, while Kelvin starts at absolute zero.

questions.explanation: Gas laws require absolute temperature. Celsius ratios are invalid because 0 C is not absolute zero.
